title: Community Rules & Site Care Charges: Payment, Waivers and Appeals
content:
This provision governs payment, waiver and appeal of charges on the Community Rules & Site Care statement.

## Payment

- The former rule that rules and site-care charges fall due 30 calendar days after posting is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis for past-due amounts.
- Rules and site-care charges are paid through the accepted payment channels and applied to the oldest charge first. No late fee is ever charged on them.

## Appeals

1. A resident may appeal a self-help, repeat-violation, pet or vehicle charge on the grounds that the item was the plan's responsibility, was cured on or before the deadline, the notice was never served, the amount is wrong, or the animal is an assistance animal.
2. An appeal must be received no later than the appeal window, in calendar days, after the date of the charge appealed, that date being the charge date on the statement. The window is counted in calendar days starting the day after the charge date, and an appeal received on the last day is in time.
3. The community manager decides an appeal within the decision period. An upheld appeal waives the whole charge, the basis of the waiver being the upheld appeal; a denied appeal leaves the charge due.
4. Plan fees are not appealable; a disputed plan fee is a billing correction.

## Waivers

| Charge | Waiver | Basis recorded |
|---|---|---|
| Appealed and the appeal upheld | the whole charge | appeal upheld |
| Posted for an item the plan covered, whether or not appealed | in full | plan coverage |
| Posted in error | in full | billing error |
| Already carrying a waiver | not waived again | — |

## Boundary case on the appeal window

Hypothetical charge dated 10 April, with the 14-day window the statement terms show: counting starts 11 April and the last day is 24 April. An appeal received on 24 April is in time; one received on 25 April is not.

## Hypothetical illustration of oldest-first application

A statement carries a $50.00 charge dated in March and a $40.00 charge dated in April. A payment of $70.00 settles the March charge and leaves $20.00 of the April charge unpaid.
